search_text: published ZDI-17-1009 ZDI-CAN-4755 Symantec Messaging Gateway Export Servlet snmpFileName Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2017-12-20 CVE-2017-15532 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-15532 4.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:S/C:P/I:N/A:N ['Symantec'] ['Messaging Gateway'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Symantec Messaging Gateway. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the export servlet. When parsing the snmpFileName parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose sensitive information under the context of the web service. Symantec has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
